responsibility: Builds IRA’s internal representation of a function before register allocation. It creates the loop-tree region hierarchy, allocnos, objects, copies, preferences, and regno-to-allocno maps; invokes cost computation and live-range construction; forms and prunes allocation regions; propagates allocno information across nested regions; creates caps for regional allocation; and prepares conflict-related numbering and summary statistics. Its output is the core IRA IR consumed by later conflict building, coloring, and code-emission stages.
